span.div:
Provides BPMN/CMMN/DMN XML
model definitions to

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Loads, validates, and stores
BPMN/CMMN/DMN XML definitions
and their revisions.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Manages transitions between
model revisions for active
entities, including rollback.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Persists the event-sourced
log of state transitions.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Groups entities sharing the
same triggering event and
model revision into
fixed-size batches, and
dispatches one Laravel queue
job per batch for horizontal
scale-out.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
